metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: How BIShare collects, uses, and protects your data across local transfers and remote transfers.

overview.p1: BIShare (“we,” “our,” or “us”) operates the BIShare mobile applications (iOS and Android), the desktop application (Windows and macOS), and the website located at <link>bishare.app</link> (collectively, the “Service”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our Service.
overview.p2: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not access or use the Service.

collect.filesDesc: When you use our remote transfer features (a share link, QR code, 6-character code, or a room), your files are stored temporarily on our relay and automatically deleted after 24 hours. We do not access, view, scan, or analyze the content of your files.
collect.deviceDesc: We collect device type, operating system version, app version, and language preference for analytics and compatibility purposes.
collect.usageDesc: We collect anonymous, aggregated statistics about platform distribution, country (via IP geolocation), and connection type. This data cannot identify individual users.
collect.ipDesc: We temporarily log IP addresses for rate limiting and abuse prevention. IP addresses are not stored permanently or associated with your identity.
collect.localDesc: Files transferred between devices on the same local network (LAN) are sent directly peer-to-peer. These transfers never pass through our servers, and we have no access to or knowledge of them.
collect.clipDesc: Clipboard synchronization operates entirely over your local network via UDP broadcast. Clipboard data never reaches our servers.
collect.contentDesc: We do not scan, analyze, index, or view the content of any files you share through our Service.

use.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
use.provideDesc: Facilitating file transfers, generating share links and transfer codes, and enabling rooms for group transfers.
use.improveDesc: Analyzing anonymous usage patterns to improve performance, fix bugs, and develop new features.
use.securityDesc: Detecting and preventing abuse, enforcing rate limits, and protecting against unauthorized access.
use.communicateDesc: Sending essential service notifications when necessary. We do not send marketing emails.

storage.encryption: All file transfers support end-to-end encryption using industry-standard AES-256-GCM encryption with Curve25519 key exchange. When encryption is enabled, only the sender and recipient can access the file content — our servers cannot decrypt it. All connections to our servers use TLS (HTTPS) encryption in transit.
storage.infrastructure: Our servers are hosted in secure, SOC 2-compliant data centers. File storage uses encrypted-at-rest cloud infrastructure with automatic redundancy. Access to production systems is restricted to authorized personnel with multi-factor authentication.

sharing.intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share data only in the following limited circumstances:
sharing.providersDesc: We use trusted third-party infrastructure providers for hosting, file storage, and content delivery. These providers process data on our behalf and are contractually obligated to protect it.
sharing.legalDesc: We may disclose information if required by law, subpoena, or court order, or if necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of BIShare, our users, or the public.

rights.intro: BIShare has no user accounts, so there is no profile, password, or stored personal data tied to you. You retain the following control over your data:

items.title: No Account
items.desc: BIShare does not require an account. There is no profile or stored personal data to access, correct, or delete.

items.title: Local Transfers Collect Nothing
items.desc: Files sent over your local network go directly between devices and never reach our servers, so nothing is collected.

items.title: Revocation
items.desc: Revoke any active share link or transfer code at any time.

items.title: Automatic Deletion
items.desc: Remote transfer files are deleted automatically after 24 hours, or immediately after the first download for one-time links.

children.text: Our Service is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will take steps to delete such information.

international.text: Our servers are located in the Asia-Pacific region. If you access the Service from outside this region, please be aware that your data may be transferred to, stored, and processed in a different jurisdiction. By using the Service, you consent to the transfer of information to countries that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence.

changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date. Your continued use of the Service after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

contact.intro: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

eligibility.text: You must be at least 13 years old to use the Service. If you are under 18, you represent that you have your parent or guardian’s permission to use the Service. By using the Service, you represent and warrant that you meet these eligibility requirements.

description.localDesc: Direct peer-to-peer file sharing between devices on the same local network, without server intermediation.
description.remoteDesc: Cloud-relayed file transfer for devices on different networks, with temporary server storage (24-hour expiry).
description.webDesc: Browser-based file upload and download via <link>bishare.app</link>, accessible without installing an application.
description.requestDesc: The ability to create links that allow others to send files directly to you, with temporary server storage.
description.roomsDesc: Temporary shared spaces where multiple users can share files simultaneously.
